$comment: Issue #314: the electron build must emit dist-electron/workers/job-worker.js so runJob callers (book/markdown import, enrollment) can spawn it in dev and packaged builds. test:job-worker asserts the emitted file exists — a check that fails against the pre-#314 build (verified before implementation). `npm run build` is deliberately not a criterion: vite-plugin-electron launches Electron after building, which hangs the engine.
